answer: An admission auction stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch, 200 lotus stalls are auctioned; the highest bidders win one each. A walnut seller who wins pays once and earns undiluted fees. An attacker needing 1,000 fakes must outbid honest traders 1,000 times: at 40 coins each, that is 40,000 coins. Bids lock for 20 epochs and return only after honest work, so a plume of copycats cannot grab rewards and vanish; cheating forfeits the bid.
